card.name: Degree words after a verb
card.fires_on: Degree or amount words such as most, more, a lot, a bit, dramatically and further that come right after a verb or phrase. They say how much or how often something happens.

modes.label: Most / more after verb
modes.description: The word most or more follows a verb and marks degree or frequency.
modes.example: it is part 3 that fired me up the<< most>> about this book

modes.label: Small amount words
modes.description: The words lot or bit follow 'a' to say how much.
modes.example: I had to crop it a<< bit>> to fit here

modes.label: Adverb of degree
modes.description: An adverb like dramatically or further ends a verb phrase.
modes.example: it will minimize your electrical bills<< dramatically>>.

card.plain: It marks words that say how much or how often something is done, such as 'more' or 'a bit', right after a verb.
